Frame_1: The sandwich rests open-faced on a white cutting board with an intricate black illustration, offering a glimpse into the initial stages of preparation. The bottom slice of bread is topped with a layer of green lettuce leaves, crisp and freshly torn, peeking out unevenly from the edges. The top slice of bread is absent, indicating the sandwich maker's process is still underway. Ingredients are scattered around the board: a jar of pickles, a pack of sliced cheese still partly wrapped, and a container of lettuce, suggesting a variety of textures and flavors to be added.
Frame_2: In this moment, the sandwich begins to take on a more complex structure. The same bottom slice of bread, previously adorned only with lettuce, now also carries a generous addition of sliced ham, its pink hues contrasting with the green lettuce. The maker's hand firmly presses down on the top slice of bread, which has been placed over the ingredients, indicating the action of closing the sandwich. The surrounding area remains cluttered with the aforementioned ingredients and utensils, highlighting the dynamic nature of the meal's assembly.
Frame_3: Here, the sandwich appears almost complete. The top slice of bread has been folded over, partially covering the layers of lettuce and ham beneath it. The hand of the sandwich maker is in the process of fine-tuning the assembly, with fingers gently adjusting the fillings to ensure an even distribution. The area around the sandwich seems undisturbed from the previous state, with the open container of lettuce and unused slices of cheese suggesting that no further ingredients will be added to this particular sandwich.
State_change_caption: The sandwich undergoes a clear transformation through these frames. Initially, it starts as an open canvas with only the base of lettuce, inviting more flavors to be layered. As the process unfolds, the ham is introduced, adding a new color and a promise of savory taste. Finally, the bread is folded over to encapsulate the fillings, transitioning from an open-faced state to a nearly finished sandwich. The maker's hands are involved throughout, pressing and adjusting, illustrating a personal touch in the meal's creation. The surrounding ingredients, mostly unchanged, bear witness to the sandwich's evolution from simple beginnings to a more complete, ready-to-eat state.
